'''2012 Bespin Regionals Jim Li DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jim Li]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Username:''' jimli
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
